featured_reviews.review_text:

Food was very good and fresh. Bombil were delicious. Surmai thali, tandoor surmai thali was delicious. Prawns Koliwada was very good too. Chicken thali was delicious. Overall a great experience.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The Bombil fry was crispy and delicious, with three pieces served—quite satisfying. The Prawns Koliwada arrived hot and tasted really good. The Surmai tawa fry was just okay, nothing exceptional but decent.
The highlight was the Prawns Masala Thali. It is very cost-friendly and offers great value for money. The thali includes a good variety of items such as rice, three breads of your choice, prawns curry, papad, sukha machi, thecha, and sol kadi.

featured_reviews.review_text: Tried the Mutton Thali, Chicken Malai Kebab, and Bombil Fish Fry—all absolutely worth it. Had to wait around 10 minutes, but the wait was totally justified. Service was quick, food came hot, and the seating is comfortable. Really liked how well they’ve managed the seating arrangement. Overall, a satisfying experience.

featured_reviews.name: Suvas Wagh
featured_reviews.review_text:
It's a great place to have sea food in Mumbai. They have Multiple outlets in Mumbai. I visited this place with friends. Tried Surmai fry, Pomfret thali, Prawns thali, Prawns kolowada, Chicken lollipop and Chicken thali. We loved the food! All the fish served was very fresh and perfectly fried with amazing taste. Even the chicken tasted great. Also the quantity of food is good compared to cost, it can be improved. Service is also good. Might face waiting time of upto 15-20 mins on weekends.

But recommend to try their sea food.

featured_reviews.review_text: This is one of the best places for seafood lover’s especially the thali. My family and I have been her a number of time and this place doesn’t disappoint. featured_reviews.name: Dipesh Malvade
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Jaihind Lunch Home, Bandra today and it turned out to be a super satisfying food experience! 🤩🍽️✨
The restaurant gives a classic Mumbai dining vibe with a lively and welcoming atmosphere 🏙️🎶. Even though the place was quite busy, the service was quick, smooth and well managed 👏⚡
⭐ What I Ordered:
🍗 Chicken Lapeta Kebab – ₹390
Absolutely delicious! Perfectly grilled, juicy, smoky and nicely spicy 🌶️🔥. Every bite was full of flavour and cooked to perfection 🤤👌 Definitely a must-try if you love spicy starters!
🥘 Sukha Chicken Thali – ₹430
Authentic coastal style dish with rich and balanced flavours 🌴🍗. It felt like proper home-style Maharashtrian food 🏡❤️. Very filling, satisfying and full paisa vasool meal 😋
🥞 Neer Dosa (3 pcs) – ₹90
Soft, light, smooth and paired perfectly with the main dish 🧈🥥. Simple but very tasty and fresh ✨
🥥 Solkadhi – ₹90
Super refreshing, cool and perfectly balanced the spice level 🧊🥤🌸 Loved the taste and freshness!
💧 Mineral Water – ₹35
💰 Total Bill – ₹1087 💳🧾
Overall, the food quality, taste, portion size and service were really impressive ⭐👏. The place is perfect for family dining 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦, friends outing 👫 and casual food plans 🍛🍹
If you are in Bandra and love authentic Maharashtrian & coastal food, you definitely need to visit 😉📍🍴

featured_reviews.name: vicky s
featured_reviews.review_text: I took surmai tawa thali. The surmai was fresh. The fish curry was yummy. Bhakri could have been better. Surmai, curry and rice together tasted heavenly. Must visit for fish lovers in BKC.

featured_reviews.name: durgesh gawde
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jai Hind is a gem for seafood lovers, offering an impressive variety of dishes, generous portions, and prices that feel genuinely value-for-money. If you’re someone who appreciates fresh, well-cooked fish without burning a hole in your pocket, this restaurant easily stands out as one of the best options in the city.

One of the first things you notice at Jai Hind is the sheer range on the menu. From classics like Surmai Fry, Bombil Fry, Rawas Curry, and Prawns Koliwada to specials like Crab Masala and Tawa Pomfret, the restaurant ensures there’s something for every seafood enthusiast. What makes the experience even better is that the quality is consistent. The fish is fresh, perfectly marinated, and cooked with authentic coastal flavours that highlight Mumbai’s rich culinary heritage.

Quantity is another major plus. Unlike many seafood places where portions feel small for the price, Jai Hind gives you hearty servings that truly justify every rupee. Whether you order a thali or an à la carte dish, the plates come generously loaded, making it easy to share or enjoy as a filling meal on your own. Their fish thalis, in particular, are a standout—they offer a balanced combination of fried fish, curry, rice, chapati, and sides, making it both wholesome and satisfying.

The pricing is surprisingly reasonable, especially considering the rising cost of seafood in the city. For the quality and quantity provided, the restaurant manages to keep its rates fair, which is a big reason people return. It’s a great place for regular seafood cravings without feeling guilty about overspending.

The ambience is simple, clean, and comfortable—nothing overly fancy, but perfectly suited for a relaxed and enjoyable meal. Service is prompt, friendly, and attentive, with staff who are happy to recommend dishes based on your taste preferences.

featured_reviews.name: PRATYUSH MISAL
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently attended the SAP Agro organic farming training, and it was a very valuable experience for me. The training was well-structured and covered practical aspects of organic farming in a simple and understandable way.

Sachin Sir was extremely helpful and knowledgeable. He patiently listened to all my problems and provided clear, practical solutions for each one. His guidance has given me more confidence to apply organic methods effectively on my farm.

The overall support system and network provided by SAP Agro is also very good. It is reassuring to know that I can stay connected and get guidance in the future as well. The availability of contact support for future planning is a big advantage.

Additionally, I appreciated:

- The focus on real field problems and practical solutions
- Step-by-step guidance for transitioning to organic farming
- Useful tips on soil health, natural inputs, and cost reduction
- Motivation to build a sustainable and profitable farming model

Overall, this training has helped me gain clarity, confidence, and direction for my farming journey. I am thankful to Sachin Sir and the SAP Agro team for their continuous support.

featured_reviews.name: sachin kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
The organic farming session by SAP Agro Services by Sachin Sir was excellent - highly informative, engaging, and well-structured explained simply. All topics were thoroughly covered in depth, including organic techniques, soil management, pest control, and certification processes with clear insights and real-life examples.
The session provided innovative organic farm planning ideas including seasonal crop planning, intercropping, efficient space utilization, crop rotation, and soil health management also covering seed selection, nursery preparation, spacing, irrigation, and harvesting with step-by-step documentation.
Organic Fruit and vegetable plantation do's and don'ts were clearly explained - proper pit preparation, organic manure use, correct spacing, mulching versus avoiding overwatering, wrong seedling selection, and improper planting depth. The training provided deep understanding of identifying genuine organic products through label reading, certification marks. The trainer's interactive approach, practical knowledge, and friendly delivery made complex concepts easily understandable and applicable to real farming situations.
I, strongly recommend SAP Agro Services for organic farming training due to excellent quality, practical approach, and comprehensive coverage. I would happily refer others to this valuable training program.

featured_reviews.name: Epic Film Studio
featured_reviews.review_text:
The organic farming session by Sachin Palkar was extremely informative and well-structured.All major topics were covered in depth, from basic soil health to advanced Organic farm planning concepts.I especially liked the clear explanation of soil testing with diagrams which made it very easy to understand practically.
The session gave new and useful ideas for organic farm planning, which can be implemented immediately.Detailed guidance on growing organic coriander, including planning on paper, spacing, and inputs, was very helpful.The organic fruit plantation do’s and don’ts were explained clearly, avoiding common mistakes farmers make.We also learned how to identify genuine organic products and fertilizers, which is very important today.Overall, the session was practical, insightful, and farmer-friendly.I would definitely recommend SAP Agro Services to others who are interested in organic farming and sustainable agriculture.

Looking forward to working together on the same platform to strengthen farmer-focused organic initiatives.

featured_reviews.name: ASHIK SHAIKH
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the opportunity to attend an organic farming training session conducted by a Mr Sachin Palkar a highly experienced horticulture expert, and I must say it exceeded all my expectations.

The trainer’s depth of experience in organic practices and horticulture was evident from the very beginning. With years of hands-on fieldwork and academic background, he explained every concept with exceptional clarity. From soil health and natural composting techniques to pest management without chemicals, every topic was covered in a structured and practical way.

What truly stood out was his ability to simplify complex topics. Even participants who were new to organic farming felt confident by the end of the session. His passion for sustainability and eco-friendly practices was inspiring, and it reflected in every part of the training.

The session also included Q&A rounds, which made learning interactive and engaging. I received practical tips that can be applied in both large-scale farming and small home gardens.

Additionally, detailed handouts, organic input preparation techniques, seasonal planning advice, and post-training support made this training truly holistic.

Whether you’re a beginner or someone looking to switch to organic practices, I highly recommend this training. The knowledge, insights, and encouragement we received were truly invaluable.

The fee he charged for the session was absolutely worth it. In fact, it wasn’t just for the session alone—he has continued to stay in touch and is actively helping me with my queries and guiding me as I start my organic business
